topic: The STAR method for interview answers
hook: Nobody tells you why interview stories fall flat.
sentences: Most stories lose the listener because they spend all their time on the action.
Imagine telling a long tale about a project without ever mentioning the payoff.
Instead of rambling, structure your reply around four clear parts.
Start with the situation to set the scene briefly.
Name the task you were personally responsible for next.
Describe the action you took and why you chose it.
Finish with the result to show exactly what changed because of your work.

cta: Which part of a project story is hardest for you to explain?
takeaway: Structure interview stories using the four stages of situation, task, action, and result.
